svg.title: fountain 模块依赖矩阵 / Module dependency matrix
svg.text: fountain 模块依赖矩阵 / Module dependency matrix
行 = 依赖方，列 = 被依赖方；两轴同一顺序（按依赖层级：基础层在左上）⇒ 依赖只落在对角线右上侧
Rows are dependents, columns are dependencies; both axes share one order (foundation top-left) ⇒ all cells sit above the diagonal
50 个模块 / 266 条依赖（都是「已声明且源码里 import 了对方 API」）；声明了但未引用对方 API 的 21 条、间接可达关系都不画；不含示例应用
50 modules / 266 dependencies (each imports the required API); 21 declared-but-unused edges are not drawn; demo apps excluded
彩色格 = 该行 API 引用量前三的依赖（116 格；色相 = 依赖方、深浅 = 引用量）；浅灰格 = 其余依赖（150 格）；列名下边的数字 = 该模块被依赖次数
Colored cells = the 3 most-called deps of that row (116); pale = the rest (150); the number under each column name = in-degree
